item.title: Dimension: connecting Rust mathematics to a renderer
item.description: Dimension is my Rust workspace for mathematics and graphics experiments. The useful starting point is mathlib: it exposes matrix storage, numerical solvers and the transformations that the rendering crate uses on the CPU.

item.title: DasherControl: a homelab dashboard built around workspaces
item.description: I started DasherControl because my homelab services kept spreading across browser tabs. The idea was a workspace of applets: bookmarks and embedded applications arranged in a dashboard, with a few Docker controls nearby.
